title: Longwood Drive Reconstruction Project
description:
Introduction
Welcome to the project page for the planned reconstruction of Longwood Drive. The City intends to completely reconstruct Longwood Drive to replace the aged watermain, sewers and road structure (i.e. sidewalk, curbs and asphalt). Introduction
Welcome to the project page for the planned reconstruction of Longwood Drive. The City intends to completely reconstruct Longwood Drive to replace the aged watermain, sewers and road structure (i.e. sidewalk, curbs and asphalt). This will also include the replacement of water and sanitary pipes up to the common property line. Subscribe and follow this project for updates and information regarding project work.
Major notices and updates will be posted here. Paper notices are also delivered residents/owners who are directly impacted (not the broader neighbourhood). Minor updates will be posted on this webpage.
